clips.meaning: A small inquisitive look-around: base swivel and two opposing shade tilts.
Lowers the visible stylus onto its fixed circular guide and traces two back-and-forth arcs while the shade aims at the pad. No new marks are generated.
Stretches into a proud upright pose and gives two delighted shade nods before folding back.
Leans toward the work pad and makes a broad slow inspection sweep, unlike the short repetitive tracing state.
